stories.summary: Ms. Kelly’s departure from Fox News will test her ability to connect with a broader audience, but the most significant implications concern the larger television news industry.

stories.headline: Comey Letter on Clinton Email Is Subject of Justice Dept. Inquiry
stories.summary: The department’s inspector general will look into James B. Comey’s hotly debated decision to inform Congress about a new review of the Hillary Clinton email case.
